_what: Schedules lane S9 (docs/schedules.md §8.1-§8.2), 2026-10-11. The POST /v1/schedules bodies that replace lane SWEEP's issue_sweep Cloud Scheduler job and the operator's session cron bdb47d30. An operator posts each body as the member named in `post_as` (that member becomes the schedule's owner, §2.7); docs/operations.md 'Schedules: the S9 migration' is the procedure. tests/unit/control_plane/test_schedules_migration_seed.py validates every body through swarm_api.schedules.build_schedule, so a body here that the API would refuse fails CI.

schedules.post_as: the member that was the tenant's issue_sweep.submit_as; since 2026-10-12, when that setting and its route were removed, the posted schedule's own owner (GET /v1/schedules/<id>)
